title: Staff Directory
story: A small company keeps its departments and employees in two connected tables. An employee's manager_id points to another employee.
schemaSql: CREATE TABLE departments (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, department_id INTEGER, manager_id INTEGER, salary INTEGER NOT NULL, hire_date TEXT NOT NULL, bonus INTEGER, email TEXT);
